name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A short, one-sentence description of the feature you would like to see.

## Problem this solves

Describe the problem or limitation you are running into. What workflow is frustrating or impossible today?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or behaviour you would like. Be as specific as you can.

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried any workarounds? Are there other ways this could be implemented?

## Privacy / performance considerations

CodeDNA has two hard constraints:

- **Zero source code storage** — no feature may store actual code content.
- **Zero network requests** — no feature may transmit data off-device without explicit user opt-in.

If your request touches either of these, please explain how it would stay within those constraints.

## Additional context

Add any screenshots, mockups, links to related issues, or examples from other tools.
